description: This Python source file defines the AnthropicSkillsConfig class, which implements configuration and transformation methods for interacting with Anthropic's Skills API. It includes methods for validating environment headers, constructing URLs, transforming requests and responses for creating, listing, retrieving, and deleting skills, as well as handling API-specific details.

classes.name: AnthropicSkillsConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Anthropic Skills API that provides methods for request/response transformation, URL construction, and environment validation tailored to Anthropic's API.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Adds necessary headers for Anthropic API, including API key and version headers, validating presence of the API key.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], endpoint: str, skill_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for Anthropic Skills endpoints, optionally including a skill ID.

methods.name: Dict transform_create_skill_request( self, create_request: CreateSkillRequest, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms a create skill request into the format expected by Anthropic.

methods.name: Skill transform_create_skill_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw HTTP response into a Skill object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_list_skills_request( self, list_params: ListSkillsParams, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the URL and query parameters for listing skills.

methods.name: ListSkillsResponse transform_list_skills_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms the list skills response JSON into a ListSkillsResponse object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_get_skill_request( self, skill_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs URL and headers for retrieving a specific skill.

methods.name: Skill transform_get_skill_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms the get skill response JSON into a Skill object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_delete_skill_request( self, skill_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs URL and headers for deleting a skill.

methods.name: DeleteSkillResponse transform_delete_skill_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms the delete skill response JSON into a DeleteSkillResponse object.
